items.quote: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
items.claim: Moses commanded Aaron and his sons to boil flesh and eat it with bread from the basket of consecrations at the tabernacle entrance
items.action: Boil the flesh and eat it
items.object: flesh and bread from the basket of consecrations
items.place: the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
